faqs.q: Sec. 18-173. - I.R.C. Section R109.1.2, Plumbing, mechanical, gas, and electrical systems inspection.
faqs.a:
Section R109.1.2. Plumbing, mechanical, gas and electrical systems inspection,
is hereby amended by amending the first paragraph in its entirety to read as follows:
"
R109.1.2. Plumbing, mechanical, gas and electrical systems inspection.
A rough mechanical, electrical, and plumbing inspection shall be made prior to rough
                  frame inspection and after the roof and roof covering, framing, fire-blocking, and
                  bracing are in place, and all vents, duct systems, piping, and HVAC equipment is properly
                  installed, including all vents, exhausts, and intakes extended through the completed
                  roof and walls."
The exception listed in Section R109.1.2 shall remain the same.
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
